LanguageData.AMUFA_AutomationOffDesc: Automatic construction and launching are paused. Click to enable.
LanguageData.AMUFA_AutomationOnDesc: Automatically construct and launch configured mining pods. Click to pause.
LanguageData.AMUFA_AutoRebuildManaged: Automatic mode has taken control of auto rebuild.
LanguageData.AMUFA_LandOffDesc: Do not construct land mining pods. Click for prototype pods.
LanguageData.AMUFA_LandProtoDesc: Construct prototype pods for land mineral sites. Click for standard pods.
LanguageData.AMUFA_LandStandardDesc: Construct standard pods for land mineral sites. Click to disable.
LanguageData.AMUFA_AsteroidOffDesc: Do not construct asteroid mining pods. Click to enable.
LanguageData.AMUFA_AsteroidOnDesc: Prioritize reachable asteroids and construct asteroid mining pods. Click to disable.
LanguageData.AMUFA_StrategyOldestDesc: Use the earliest discovered compatible target first. Click for nearest-first.
LanguageData.AMUFA_StrategyNearestDesc: Use the reachable target with the lowest fuel distance first. Click for farthest-first.
LanguageData.AMUFA_StrategyFarthestDesc: Use the farthest reachable target first. Click for first-discovered.
LanguageData.AMUFA_VacstoneOffDesc: Asteroid pods will not recover vacstone. Click to enable.
LanguageData.AMUFA_VacstoneOnDesc: Asteroid pods will recover vacstone. Click to disable.
LanguageData.AMUFA_AsteroidPodStranded: The mining unit has no reachable target at the automatic mining unit launcher's current target fuel level and will wait at the launch position.
LanguageData.AMUFA_LandOnlyMismatch: {0} is configured only for land mining pods, but currently only asteroid mining targets are available.
LanguageData.AMUFA_DuplicateAccelerated: An additional mining pod reached an occupied target. The remaining mining time has been halved.
LanguageData.AMUFA_ArrivalOnlyMessagesDesc: Hide the notification shown immediately after launch and keep the single arrival notification. Fuel, invalid-target, target-lost, and mining-complete messages are unaffected.
LanguageData.AMUFA_StatusNoReachableTarget: no reachable target is within launcher range at the current target fuel level
LanguageData.AMUFA_StatusPreparingLand: preparing to launch to a land target
LanguageData.AMUFA_StatusPreparingAsteroid: preparing to launch to an asteroid
LanguageData.AMUFA_StatusLaunchPortOccupied: launch port is occupied, preventing blueprint placement
LanguageData.AMUFA_LaunchPortOccupied: The launch port of {0} is occupied, preventing automatic mining pod blueprint placement.
LanguageData.AMUFA_RoofBlocked: The launch port of {0} is roofed. Automatic construction or launch has been paused.
LanguageData.AMUFA_DefaultSettingsHeader: Defaults for newly built automatic launchers
LanguageData.AMUFA_DefaultFuelLimitDesc: Sets the configurable target fuel level copied to each newly built automatic launcher. Whole numbers from 0 to 400 only. Existing launchers are not changed.
LanguageData.AMUFA_DefaultAutomationDesc: Sets whether each newly built automatic launcher starts with automatic operation enabled. Existing launchers are not changed.
LanguageData.AMUFA_DefaultTargetStrategyDesc: Sets the target strategy copied to each newly built automatic launcher. Existing launchers are not changed.
LanguageData.AMUFA_ResetSettingsDesc: Reset the notification option and all defaults for newly built automatic launchers. Existing launcher instances are not changed.
